rationale: C1 and C3 are police policy notes about staffing and welfare; C4 and C5 are IPS officer promotions. None shows a promotion scheme for second-level entrants or 7-year first-level personnel to Head Constable or SSI.

rationale: C4 sanctions Rs.200 crore soft loan to SIPCOT for investing companies, and C1-C3 describe existing TIIC loan products. None sets aside Rs.15,000 crore or gives low-interest loans for reviving industries and their employees. Related activity only.

cited.quote: The scheme of providing financial assistance for Repair and Renovation of Christian churches is being implemented in Tamil Nadu.

rationale: C1 describes an existing church repair grant scheme (Rs.700 lakh allocated so far) with no Rs.200 crore allocation and nothing on mosques. C4 concerns Samathuvapuram houses and C2/C3 Hindu temples. No step for the commitment.

rationale: C4 and C5 mandate PSU participation in the Trade Receivables Discounting System, a bill-payment platform. C3 gives startup procurement concessions. Neither sets a 15 percent purchase target from micro and small industries or a 10 percent discount.

rationale: C1 reports a general powerloom tariff subsidy slab scheme continuing from 2006-07 with no mention of the 20-40 hp category or tariff III A 1. C2/C3 are minimum wage notifications. No step for the commitment.

cited.quote: Subsidy assistance of 40% of the unit cost of the engine or Rs.48,000/- whichever is less is being provided

rationale: C1 describes an existing engine subsidy scheme that will be continued; it gives no order increasing the percentage and no earlier 20 percent baseline. C2 covers FRP boats with engines at 40 percent. No GO raising the engine subsidy is shown.

cited.quote: 1,000 no. of OBM/IBE have been supplied at a total subsidy of Rs.4.80 crore

rationale: C1 reports engine supply under the 2020-21 scheme, which predates this government, and says the scheme continues. No extract shows an enhanced engine subsidy or its disbursement beginning.

rationale: C1 and C3 describe existing SHG loan and interest-subsidy schemes, C4 a goat scheme and C5 SHG work sheds. None offers 25 percent subsidy against a 10 percent group investment with priority government procurement. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Matching grants would be intended for first time entrepreneurs, women led businesses,

rationale: C3 mentions planned matching grants under TNRTP with no sanction, and C1/C2 describe existing SHG loan schemes. C4 creates livelihood parks and C5 is farm machinery subsidy. No 25 percent assistance with 10 percent contribution or 10 percent procurement incentive.

cited.quote: Presently, a monthly pension of Rupees Ten Thousand is being paid to 232 journalists through banks.

rationale: C1 and C2 describe the existing journalists' pension and family pension with no order raising the amount. C3-C5 concern government employee pension and interest rates, a different group. No review or increase of the journalists' pension is shown.

rationale: C1 says the existing 1959 Act already provides an Advisory Committee headed by the Chief Minister; it records no new constitution step. C4 is a NEET committee and C5 a sanitation mission committee. No new step for this commitment.
